editorial:
Imagine your favorite superheroes getting kidnapped and the only ones left to save them are their pets. That is the fun setup here. Krypto, Superman's loyal dog, teams up with a group of shelter animals who just gained superpowers. You get Ace the hound, PB the pig, Merton the turtle, and Chip the squirrel, each with their own funny abilities. The movie mixes big action with silly jokes, so both kids and adults can enjoy it. The animation looks bright and colorful, and the voice cast brings a lot of energy. It never takes itself too seriously, which keeps things light and fun.

The pacing moves quickly, with plenty of laughs and heart along the way. Some jokes land better than others, and the story follows a pretty familiar path, but the charm of the animal characters carries it. If you want a feel-good family night, this is a great pick.
endingExplained: In the final act, Lulu the guinea pig uses orange kryptonite to give herself powers and tries to take over Metropolis. Krypto and the shelter pack team up to stop her. After a big battle, the pets defeat Lulu and free the Justice League. Krypto also learns to share Superman with Lois Lane. The shelter animals find loving homes, and Krypto joins them as a family, setting up future adventures together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves animated superhero adventures and family-friendly comedy.
